text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that concludes our meeting. 
Since this weekend will be for resting—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... isn't it about 
time we use it? The 'Hot Springs Trip 
Ticket', I mean."
And so—!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The shuttle bus meeting spot is... around 
here, right.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Still, to think it would actually snow. 
Though it seems to have only left a light 
dusting.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The temperature has dropped quite a bit, 
hasn't it?
choice_data_list: Still, in a way, it's actually perfect!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. We're going to a hot spring, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... Grandmother said 
something before too. That she prefers 
visiting hot springs on cold days."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
She said it feels great to slowly warm up 
from your core when your body's freezing 
cold...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The hot spring we're visiting today... As 
expected of a grand prize, it looked quite 
magnificent.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I want to take them there. Someday.
choice_data_list:
Then today and tomorrow, let's treat it as 
a scouting trip too!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. If possible, by 
all means.

And so... after arriving at the hot spring 
town near the inn, we spent the time 
looking around the local sights while 
doing a bit of scouting.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...It was very fascinating, in many ways.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"It seems to be an old hot spring town 
with plenty of historic buildings. ...I 
wonder if Grandpa would enjoy it too."
choice_data_list:
Let's buy a bunch of different souvenirs 
and try them out!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Yes, that's true. There are so many 
different shops offering a wide variety of 
onsen manju.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I want to buy a few... and taste-test them 
at the inn.

And so, we went around buying souvenirs, 
and afterwards—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That was a lovely bath. The view from the 
open-air bath was... beautiful, too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Also, about the manjū... I really liked 
the one with chestnut paste.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: How about you, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Hmm, it's hard to decide, but...

text_block_list.text:
And while we chatted away like that, the 
night grew deeper...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... It's getting pretty late. Well then, 
I'll head back to my room.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Breakfast will be in the dining hall at 
7:30 tomorrow, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. Good night.

And the next morning. After having 
breakfast, we were just about to board the 
bus back in the afternoon, but—
choice_data_list: Huh! The shuttle bus isn't running...!?

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry! It snowed heavily 
again last night, and the roads are 
completely blocked...

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
"They say snow removal should be finished 
by tonight and we'll be able to move 
again, so we deeply apologize, but could 
you please wait until then?"

text_block_list.name: Landlady of the Inn
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, we will leave the room as it 
is so that you can relax and make yourself 
at home."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I thought staying in my room all day 
wouldn't do any good, so I got dressed and 
came out, but...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I already went everywhere I needed to go 
yesterday, didn't I...?)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (There's no... destination...)
choice_data_list:
…Wanna take a break at that Japanese-style 
café for now?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
In that case, the green tea and oshiruko 
set, please... Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Inside the store... it's so warm. Ah, 
there's a wood-burning stove lit over 
there.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list:
Fire... somehow, you can just stare at it 
forever, huh.

Fire... somehow, you can just stare at it 
forever, right?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Around here... isn't really a tourist 
spot anymore, more like a neighborhood 
park where locals drop by.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
choice_data_list:
Oh. Looks like there are ducks over by the 
lake.
Oh. There are ducks over by the lake, huh?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
There they are... about four of them. 
Swimming side by side...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...So cute.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...It's so peaceful.)

I had gone out for a stroll, but 
eventually ran out of places to go... 
Before I knew it, I was just staring 
blankly out the inn's window, sipping tea.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Work. I feel more at ease when I'm 
working."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Deciding what needs to be done, 
focusing... and working away in silence is 
what I prefer."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Still...—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(There's nothing. Nothing I can do, 
nothing I should do. There's just... 
nothing...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Just spending time... with you.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ......Even with something like this.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: It's strangely calming, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ............That's news to me.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between Believe and 
myself...
